findings.msg: VERIFY runs a test file as a script (godot -s <test>.gd): a GUT test is not a SceneTree script, so it can never pass - use addons/gut/gut_cmdln.gd -gtest=<file>
VERIFY can never run: runs a test file as a script (godot -s tests/test_window_config.gd): a GUT test is not a SceneTree script - use addons/gut/gut_cmdln.gd -gtest=res://<test>.gd
